recipes.name: Sun-Dried Tomato & White Bean Dip
instructions: Heat the oil in a medium pan over high heat. Cook the onion for 4 minutes, or until golden. Then add the garlic and cook for another couple of minutes, until fragrant.
Add the cooked onion, garlic, and all remaining ingredients, excluding the chives, to a food processor and blend until smooth. Then stir in the chives by hand.
Serve immediately, or cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight to allow the flavours to meld. Drizzle with olive oil and a bit of balsamic vinegar before serving, if desired. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
